queue.name: Shutterstock Contributor
queue.why: Tried 2026-10-03. Help articles on submit.shutterstock.com/help confirm 6 earnings levels from 15% to 40% that reset each January 1, but the download thresholds per level are only on submit.shutterstock.com/payouts, which returns a browser-not-supported page to fetches. Needs a real browser.

queue.name: Lulu
queue.why: Rates verified 2026-10-03 on help.lulu.com (Creator Revenue: The Basics, article 64000255464; Creator Revenue Guide, 64000262744): Lulu Bookstore print = 80% of gross profit to creator, 20% to Lulu, after print cost; Global Distribution = 50% of list price to the channel, then the same 80/20 split after print cost; ebooks 90/10. Not added because 20% of (price minus print cost) needs a negative per_unit term, which the fee table renders as a negative dollar rate. Needs a small build.py/schema tweak (for example a rate text override) before it can ship cleanly.

queue.name: IngramSpark
queue.why: Wholesale discount + print cost model. Partly verified 2026-10-03: the 2026 rate card PDF (ingramspark.com/hubfs/Rate%20Card_IngramSpark_2026.pdf, effective February 1, 2026) says compensation is list price less discount less print cost and shows a fee of 1.875% of the local list price at the time of sale; the user guide PDF recommends a 53% to 55% discount. Still open: the row label and deduction rule for the 1.875% (the user guide example leaves it out) and the minimum wholesale discount, which is only on the title setup page behind a login.
